intro.title: What is a WhatsApp chatbot?
intro.definition: is an automated assistant on your WhatsApp Business number. It greets customers, shows menus and buttons, books slots, takes orders and payments, answers questions in their language, and passes the conversation to a person whenever it should — all inside the app your customers open every day.

items.question: How do I try the live demo?
items.answer: Enter your name and work email in the demo section on this page. We email you a six-digit code; enter it and the demo opens right here, or full screen in a new tab. There is no password, and your demo access stays until you sign out.

items.question: Do you use the official WhatsApp Business API?
items.answer: Yes. Every bot we build runs on Meta’s WhatsApp Cloud API with your verified business number, approved message templates and Meta’s webhook signing — never unofficial automation tools that risk a ban.

items.question: Can the bot understand typed messages, not only buttons?
items.answer: Yes. Menus and buttons keep common journeys fast, and AI understands free-typed replies — dates, quantities, names and questions — so customers can chat the way they normally do.

items.question: How long does it take to launch?
items.answer: A focused bot — bookings, ordering or support — typically goes live in two to four weeks, including Meta business verification, template approval and testing on your own number.

items.question: Can it connect to our existing systems?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate with CRMs, ERPs, booking and payment systems and helpdesks over their APIs, so orders, appointments and leads land where your team already works.
